original_source.title: Xiaomi 13 Pro - Home - 'Add a song' page fails to load with 'Couldn't reach Genius' error
original_source.preconditions: Genius Android app installed from Google Play; active Wi-Fi connection verified working on mobile web genius.com.
steps_to_reproduce: 2. Tap the pencil icon in the upper-right corner of the Home screen.
4. Tap the refresh/retry icon several times.
original_source.expected_result: The Add a song page should load successfully in the Android app, as it does on the mobile web version.
original_source.actual_result: The Add a song page in the Genius Android app displays 'Couldn't reach Genius' and remains unavailable after tapping Retry several times. The same Add Song feature loads successfully in the mobile web version of genius.com on the same device and network.

attachments.description: Highlighted screenshot of 'Couldn't reach Genius' error screen
Screen recording from app launch through tapping Add a song and retry
Android logcat captured via `adb logcat -v threadtime > genius_add_a_song.log`

review_outcome.resolution_notes: Verified Approved in Cycle 562000 (documented in BUG_LESSONS.md #3, MASTER_BUG_LIBRARY.md #4, and guidelines/mobile_testing_guide.md lines 244-257).

normalized_fields.defect_category: App vs Mobile-Web Parity Failure / Dead Feature Endpoint

agent_analysis.why_approved_high_value: Proved the failure was an app defect—not a local Wi-Fi outage—by contrasting the native Android app error ('Couldn't reach Genius') with the mobile web version (`genius.com`) loading the exact same 'Add a song' feature on the same device and network.

inferred_lessons: When a native app shows a network/connection error on a specific feature, immediately test the same feature on mobile web on the same device and Wi-Fi network, and cite that comparison in Actual Results to rule out network blame.

original_source.title: Xiaomi 13 Pro - Lyrics / Annotation - Highlight annotation covers only part of the lyric line
original_source.preconditions: Genius Android app installed from Google Play; In Scope explicitly includes 'Tạo lyrics card, annotation và chia sẻ'.
steps_to_reproduce: 2. Search for and open a song with annotated lyrics.
3. View the highlighted annotation span across the lyric text.
original_source.expected_result: The annotation highlight background covers the full height/span of the annotated lyric text.
original_source.actual_result: The highlight annotation covers only part of the lyric text.

attachments.description: Highlighted screenshot showing partial annotation highlight
Screen recording of opening the song and viewing annotation highlight

review_outcome.resolution_notes: Verified Approved at Low severity in Cycle 562000 (documented in BUG_LESSONS.md #4 and MASTER_BUG_LIBRARY.md #5).

agent_analysis.why_approved_high_value: Even though severity was Low and type was Visual, annotations are Genius's core product feature and were explicitly in scope.

inferred_lessons: Do not self-censor valid Low-severity visual defects when they affect a core in-scope feature and are not excluded by Out-of-Scope rules.
